datasets.help: The row with the two category columns, each column described individually under keys. Both are required for a chart. To clear, set one empty row ([{ x: null, g: null }]); [] is rejected.

x.label: X
x.title: 1st category (X — sets column widths)
x.help: The category column (slot x); its values become the columns along the x axis. Required, empty until one is chosen.

g.label: G
g.title: 2nd category (G — sets segment heights)
g.help: The group column (slot g); its values split each column into segments. Required, empty until one is chosen.

stats.help: The cross table, each figure described individually under keys; null while a required slot is empty.

activeColumnSlots.help: The slot keys a row of the datasets carries: x, g.

crossTab.help: Categories and groups (name, count per category, segment colour) from the chosen columns, as the chart draws them; empty while a slot is empty.

MosaicStats.categories: The categories of the X column, one column per category; the table shows them as rows. The corner of the table shows “X column \ G column”, that is the name of the X column, then that of the G column.
MosaicStats.groups: Per group the counts over all categories; the table shows each group as a column with the colour of its segment.
MosaicStats.rowTotals: The total per category over all groups, in category order; the table shows it in the last column.
MosaicStats.colTotals: The total per group over all categories, in group order; the table shows it in the last row.
MosaicStats.total: The grand total of all counts, that is the number of rows; the table shows it at the bottom right under the “Total” header.

MosaicGroup.name: The name of the group, a value of the G column; the table shows it as column header next to the colour swatch of the segment.
MosaicGroup.counts: The number of rows with this group and this X category, in category order.
